title: C++ Programming
description: Comprehensive directed learning tree to master C++ from basic syntax to manual memory management, STL containers, OOP, template metaprogramming, and system programming.

nodes.title: Foundations
nodes.description: C++ history, compiler installation, Hello World, primitive types, operators, and control flow.

children.title: History of C & C++
children.description: Evolution of C, Bjarne Stroustrup's C with Classes, ANSI/ISO standard revisions (C++11 to C++23).

children.title: Installing Compiler (GCC, Clang, MSVC)
children.description: Setting up MinGW, GCC, Clang, or Visual Studio compiler toolchains and PATH environment.

children.title: Hello World in C++
children.description: Main entry point, preprocessor directives (#include <iostream>), return 0, and compilation steps.

children.title: Input/Output (cin, cout)
children.description: Stream insertion (<<) and extraction (>>) operators, std::endl vs '\n', cin.getline().

children.title: Variables & Data Types
children.description: Primitive types (int, float, double, char, bool), auto type deduction, sizeof operator.

children.title: Operators (Arithmetic, Relational, Logical)
children.description: Arithmetic, logical, bitwise, assignment, and ternary conditional operators.

children.title: Control Flow (if, switch, loops)
children.description: Conditional branching, switch-case, for loops, range-based for loops, while and do-while loops.

nodes.title: Core C++
nodes.description: Functions, parameter passing, pointers, references, arrays, strings, structures, and namespaces.

children.title: Functions & Overloading
children.description: Function signature, pass-by-value vs pass-by-reference, default arguments, inline functions, method overloading.

children.title: Scope & Storage Classes
children.description: Local, global, static, register, extern, and thread_local storage specifiers.

children.title: Pointers & References
children.description: Pointer declaration, address-of (&), dereference (*), pointer arithmetic, references vs pointers, const pointers.

children.title: Arrays & Strings
children.description: Fixed C-style arrays, multidimensional arrays, std::string methods, and string_view.

children.title: Structures & Enums
children.description: struct data alignment, unions, enum and strongly-typed enum class.

children.title: Namespaces
children.description: Preventing name collisions, using namespace directive, nested namespaces, and anonymous namespaces.

nodes.title: Object-Oriented Programming
nodes.description: Classes, constructors, encapsulation, inheritance hierarchy, virtual functions, and abstract classes.

children.title: Classes & Objects
children.description: Class declaration, public/private/protected access specifiers, object instantiation, and this pointer.

children.title: Constructors & Destructors
children.description: Default, parameterized, copy, move constructors, initializer lists, and ~Destructor cleanup.

children.title: Encapsulation & Abstraction
children.description: Data hiding, interface design, const member functions, and getter/setter encapsulation.

children.title: Inheritance (Single, Multiple, Hierarchical)
children.description: Derived classes, mode of inheritance, virtual base classes, and resolving diamond problem.

children.title: Polymorphism (Compile-time, Runtime)
children.description: Function & operator overloading vs virtual function dynamic binding and override specifier.

children.title: Abstract Classes & Interfaces
children.description: Pure virtual functions (= 0), abstract base classes, dynamic_cast, and interface implementation.

nodes.title: Memory Management
nodes.description: Stack vs heap memory, dynamic memory allocation with new/delete, RAII pattern, and smart pointers.

children.title: Dynamic Memory Allocation
children.description: new and delete operators, allocating dynamic arrays (new[] / delete[]), and bad_alloc exception.

children.title: Stack vs Heap
children.description: Memory layout of C++ executable: Stack frame allocation speed vs Heap dynamic allocation durability.

children.title: Smart Pointers
children.description: std::unique_ptr, std::shared_ptr, std::weak_ptr, make_unique, and make_shared memory safety.

children.title: RAII Pattern
children.description: Resource Acquisition Is Initialization resource management, exception safety guarantees.

children.title: Memory Leaks & Valgrind
children.description: Dangling pointers, memory leaks, double free errors, debugging with Valgrind / AddressSanitizer.

nodes.title: Standard Template Library (STL)
nodes.description: Sequence containers, associative containers, iterators, generic STL algorithms, and functors.

children.title: Containers
children.description: std::vector, std::list, std::deque, std::set, std::map, std::unordered_map, std::priority_queue.

children.title: Iterators
children.description: Input, output, forward, bidirectional, random-access iterators, std::begin() and std::end().

children.title: Algorithms
children.description: std::sort, std::find, std::binary_search, std::transform, std::accumulate, std::for_each.

children.title: Custom Comparators
children.description: Lambda comparators, struct operator(), std::greater, std::less for sorting custom classes.

children.title: Functors & Lambdas
children.description: Function objects, inline lambda expressions with capture lists ([&], [=]), std::function.

nodes.title: Modern C++ Features
nodes.description: C++11 through C++20 standard updates, move semantics, auto, constexpr, lambdas, and type traits.

children.title: C++11/14/17/20 Overview
children.description: Evolution of Modern C++ standards, range loops, nullptr, override, final, enum class.

children.title: Rvalue References
children.description: T&& rvalue reference mechanics, lvalues vs rvalues, std::move, std::forward.

children.title: Move Semantics
children.description: Move constructor, move assignment operator, Rule of 5, zero-copy optimization.

children.title: Lambda Expressions
children.description: Generic lambdas, mutable lambdas, stateless vs stateful lambda captures.

children.title: auto & decltype
children.description: Automatic type deduction rules, decltype(auto), trailing return types.

children.title: Optional, Variant, Any
children.description: Type-safe vocabulary types: std::optional, std::variant with std::visit, std::any.

children.title: Constexpr & Consteval
children.description: Compile-time evaluation with constexpr functions, consteval immediate functions, constinit.

nodes.title: Advanced Concepts
nodes.description: Templates, metaprogramming, exception safety, multithreading concurrency, and atomic operations.

children.title: Templates & Generic Programming
children.description: Function templates, class templates, template specialization, variadic templates.

children.title: Template Metaprogramming
children.description: SFINAE (Substitution Failure Is Not An Error), std::enable_if, C++20 concepts and constraints.

children.title: Exception Handling
children.description: try-catch blocks, throw, exception hierarchies, noexcept specifier, stack unwinding.

children.title: Smart Pointer Internals
children.description: Custom implementation of unique_ptr and shared_ptr control block with reference counts.

children.title: Multithreading & Concurrency
children.description: std::thread, std::mutex, std::lock_guard, std::unique_lock, std::condition_variable.

children.title: Atomic Operations & Locks
children.description: std::atomic, lock-free data structures, memory barriers, std::async, and std::future.

nodes.title: System Programming
nodes.description: File I/O, inter-process communication, sockets, CLI tool development, and performance optimization.

children.title: File I/O
children.description: std::ifstream, std::ofstream, std::fstream, binary file I/O, std::filesystem library.

children.title: Inter-Process Communication
children.description: Shared memory, named pipes, message queues, and OS process signaling.

children.title: Networking & Sockets
children.description: POSIX / Winsock socket programming, TCP/UDP client-server architecture.

children.title: Building CLI Tools
children.description: Parsing command-line flags, terminal formatting, and native binary distribution.

children.title: Performance Optimization
children.description: Cache locality, cache-friendly data layouts, avoiding unnecessary allocations, profiling with gprof.

nodes.title: Projects
nodes.description: Hands-on projects building CLI tools, custom data structures, multithreaded servers, and system software in C++.

children.title: Console Calculator
children.description: CLI calculator parsing infix mathematical expressions into reverse polish notation (RPN).

children.title: Custom STL Container
children.description: Implementing a custom dynamic array or hash map class template with custom iterators.

children.title: File Encryption Tool
children.description: CLI file encryption/decryption program using AES/XOR streams and binary file handling.

children.title: Multithreaded Web Server
children.description: High-performance HTTP web server utilizing socket programming, thread pool, and non-blocking I/O.

children.title: Bank Management System
children.description: Object-oriented banking software with binary file storage, transaction records, and user security.

children.title: Game Engine Core
children.description: 2D game engine loop featuring entity component system (ECS), input handling, and SFML rendering.

nodes.title: Interview Preparation
nodes.description: C++ interview preparation covering pointers, virtual tables, memory management, STL internals, and competitive coding.

children.title: C++ Core Concepts Q&A
children.description: Reviewing compilation phases, undefined behavior, linkage, storage classes, and constness.

children.title: STL & Algorithms Q&A
children.description: Time complexity trade-offs between vector vs list vs deque vs unordered_map.

children.title: Pointers & Memory Q&A
children.description: Memory leaks, double free, dangling references, vtable mechanics, and smart pointer internals.

children.title: Concurrency Q&A
children.description: Race conditions, data races, atomic operations, mutex deadlocks, and condition variables.

children.title: OOP in C++ Q&A
children.description: Diamond problem, virtual inheritance, copy elision, RVO, and RAII design pattern questions.

children.title: Coding Challenges
children.description: Solving top C++ LeetCode / AlgoMaster data structure & algorithm problems under time constraints.
